'''Redweed''' was a type of [[Fern (plant)/Legends|fern]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the plains of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] that had multiple [[Color/Legends|red]] fronds. The [[Singing Mountain Clan]] of the [[Witches of Dathomir]] used the fronds of the Redweed for their healing properties, while the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Coven/Legends|coven]] utilized them to cause harm.<ref name="Toil" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWGdate">{{GalaxiesAED}} takes place in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:SWG timeline|here]].</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Dathomirian [[Witch/Legends|witch]] [[Rubina]] asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to infiltrate either the Singing Mountain Clan or the Nightsisters,<ref name="MTMW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meet the Mysterious Witch|Dathomir}}</ref> which resulted in the individual gathering Redweed fronds.<ref name="Toil" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Redweed first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=location|Greater Misty Falls|Dathomir}}</ref> The fern was first identified in the "[[W:c:swg:Toil and Trouble|Toil and Trouble]]" mission of the "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]]" update,<ref name="Toil" /> completely released on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="Update">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=69012|text=''Star Wars Galaxies'': Game Update 19 – December 14, 2010|nobackup=1}}</ref>

In the Prologue for the Theme Park,<ref name="Toil" /> released on [[November 4]], 2010,<ref name="Prologue">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68978&month=112010|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Witches of Dathomir Prologue &ndash; Game Update 18.2 &ndash; Thursday, November 4th}}</ref> which contains a slightly similar story to the final release, Rubina will assign the player to gather Redweed fronds as well as several other plants to gift to either the Singing Mountain Clan or the Nightsisters. After the player acquires three of each plant, they place them in a storage basket and deliver them to their clan of choice.<ref name="Toil" />

In the final release of the Theme Park, Rubina does not assign the mission and instead influences the player to infiltrate either the Nightsisters or Singing Mountain Clan.<ref name="WoDTP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park}}</ref> If the player chooses the Nightsisters, the player may meet the Nightsister herbalist [[Satra]], who will provide them the same task as Rubina in the Prologue, but instead the player must collect five of each plant instead of three.<ref name="Nightsisters">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Nightsisters' Toil and Trouble|Dathomir}}</ref> If the player chooses the Singing Mountain Clan, the player may meet the Singing Mountain herbalist [[Telo (Dathomirian)|Telo]], who will provide the same quest as Satra.<ref name="SingingMountain">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Singing Mountain Clan's Toil and Trouble|Dathomir}}</ref>
